name: Polygonzo the Faceted
description: Refuses to acknowledge curves. Animals and gems cut into triangles of hatching, dots and solid black.

designs.title: Fox Mask
designs.description: A fox's face in folded triangles, every facet with its own shading. Good on the thigh.

designs.title: Wolf Mask
designs.description: A long-jawed wolf in hard facets of black, hatch and stipple, staring straight ahead.

designs.title: Owl Mask
designs.description: An owl made of angles, with two eight-sided eyes that seem to follow you down the hall.

designs.title: Cut Diamond
designs.description: A brilliant-cut gem seen side on, each facet shaded differently, with a few small glints.

designs.title: Twenty Sides
designs.description: A many-sided solid with its faces in black, hatch and dots. Pure geometry, no animals harmed.
